mods.name: Beep's Mean Crystalline Resource Machine
mods.description: Yet another take on passive resource generation. Forge crystals and resonate them to obtain their spoils.

releases.notes:
# v1.3.0
This version introduces mob crystals, some small balance changes and bugfixes.

## Mob Crystals
Mob crystals can be created two ways
- Right click a spawner with a blank crystal to consume the spawner's mob and create a mob crystal
- Kill a certain amount of that mob, while holding the blank crystal in your offhand
Mob crystals will generate any possible item from the loot table. (e.g. iron, carrots & potatoes for zombies)
Mob crystals are not affected by Fortune & Silk touch modifiers.

Not all mobs are able to be turned into crystals, the default config prohibits bosses (ender dragon, wither & warden) and mobs without drops are also excluded on a best effort basis.

## Misc Changes
- Crucible and Former fluid renderer used wrong color
- Roll chances raised for all crystal tiers

releases.notes:
# v1.2.0
This version introduces a new machine & system to deepen how progression in the mod works

# Crystals
- Crystals now store resonance every time they are "Pinged" by a resonator

# Crystal Crucible
- Can melt down crystals to harvest the stored resonance
- Can be used to create new crafting ingredients

# Liquid Resonance Crafting Ingredients
- Activated Lapis has been added
- Pulsing Pearl has been added
- Shining Crystal has been added
- Resonating Gem has been added

# Modulators
- Recipes have been adjusted to use the new crafting ingredients

# Crystal Tiers
- Higher tier crystals will now require the new crafting ingredients

# Advancements
- A advancement tree with 8 advancements has been added 

# Ponders
- All machine ponders have been adjusted

releases.notes:
# v1.1.0
This version aims to improve both the Crystal Former & Crystal Infuser

## Crystal Former
- Now requires fuel. RF can be provided instead.
- Has a custom GUI
- Slowed down, now takes about 2 minutes to complete a crystal (was 10 seconds)
- Shift clicking no longer puts items in the wrong slot

## Crystal Infuser
- Now requires fuel. RF can be provided instead.
- Has a custom GUI

## Crystals
- Small text changes on tuning fork interaction to prevent confusion

## Resonator
- Will now activate note blocks in range
